paragraphs: Pontem Software sells cemetery management software and states over 35 years of experience. The Data Manager provides large and small cemeteries a foundation for managing Property Inventory, Ownership Details, and Interment History. Cemetery maps can be integrated with Pontem records data for administrative staff and online visitors.

Online Burial Search provides real-time information to website visitors, and gravesite mapping is among the features listed. Other features named on the page include document management, online publishing, and remote data backups. Pontem reports over 850 software implementations across the country.

Testimonials on the page come from cemetery operators, including a Director at St. Clement Cemetery, Center Line, MI. A GIS Technician at the City of Corsicana, TX and the Fayetteville Cemetery Association, Fayetteville, NY are quoted on the page.

quote.text: Pontem believes that stronger tools create stronger communities
